articles.title: Milne out for season as Hearts' injury woes continue
articles.summary: Heart of Midlothian defender Harry Milne's season is over after he sustains an anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) injury, head coach Wouter Vrancken confirms.

articles.title: Borthwick lays down World Cup challenge to England
articles.summary: With just 12 Tests remaining before the Rugby World Cup, Steve Borthwick has made it clear that he wants an England group packed with genuine contenders for a place in the final squad.
